short: Kalon Sober Living in New Jersey provides a structured and supportive environment for individuals recovering from addiction. The community focuses on building healthy routines, developing essential life skills, and encouraging long-term sobriety. Through mentorship, peer support, career guidance, therapeutic resources, and personalized support, residents can work toward greater independence and personal growth. Kalon Sober Living also offers an executive program and needs-based scholarship opportunities
